learned: Screen direction swap: v1 faces clustered at cx 0.50-0.55. Regenerated v2 shots put host at 0.297-0.360 and guest at 0.672-0.705.
Missing mic: specify a foam handheld mic in host stills and motion prompts. Check every host shot; visibility remains unverified in the notes.
2010s v2 cost $0.874 versus $1.082 in v1. Reused all six voices and corridor assets; one failed $0.15 retry left host sync at 0.009.
Reuse of stills, clips and voices cuts a rework to $0 to $0.13. A new talking clip costs about $0.15.
Lip sync remains the weak point. Sitcom5b passes 7/10 clips; replacing the doorknob improves continuity but leaves three sync failures.
Voice drift across TTS lines: earshot measured sC at 2.2x pitch spread and sitcom wife at 216-441 Hz. Reuse one voice id and review flagged lines by ear; pitch alone cannot prove voice fit.
Jumbled captions: remove highlight scaling, use a fixed word box, equal stroke and explicit spacing. Final-file OCR still finds CER 0.125 failures in 90s and marble5c.
Door-break artifacts include duplicate doors and melting. Inspect three event frames; replace failed breaks with cracking walls or falling plaster.
SFX louder than voice: remix measured sitcom active median +4.5 dB from separate stems. Lower SFX 5 dB; remeasure the final mix and keep owner listening checks.
COST_TABLE.md rounds 5 to 7 contains logged estimates, not reconciled invoices. Round 6 logs exceed the balance change by about $0.70; treat totals as upper bounds.
